summary: The progressed lunation cycle describes a roughly 29-30 year life-phase rhythm formed by the progressed Moon and progressed Sun.
body: Use this as a slow life-cycle layer, not a daily transit. The phase describes where the person is in a long arc of ending, beginning, building, visibility, sharing, revision, and release.
definition: A progressed lunation phase is measured by the angular separation between the progressed Moon and progressed Sun, mapped as an eight-phase cycle across the chart angles.
appUsage: Use as a life-phase feature with multi-year timing, not a daily notification trigger.
Calculate the phase from progressed Moon to progressed Sun separation; do not infer it from age alone.
Anchor interpretive framing to the IC, Descendant, MC, and Ascendant wave described in the framework.
Pair with Saturn Return when timing overlaps: progressed lunation describes what is ripening emotionally, while Saturn Return asks what structure can hold it.
Keep language non-fatalistic. A phase describes developmental weather, not a guaranteed event.
note: Imported from project-authored progressed lunation notes. Source file was not copied into the repository.

framework.anchor: The cycle is anchored to the IC, not 0 Aries. The eight phases map onto the chart's four angles as a wave: New Moon at the IC (bottom), First Quarter at the Descendant, Full Moon at the MC (top), Last Quarter at the Ascendant.
framework.houseProgression: New Moon = 4th, Crescent = 5th-6th, First Quarter = 7th-8th, Gibbous = 9th, Full Moon = 10th, Disseminating = 11th-12th, Last Quarter = 1st-3rd, Balsamic = end of the 3rd into a new cycle.

cycleFacts.rate: Progressed Moon moves about 13 degrees/year, progressed Sun ~1 deg/year; the Sun-Moon separation opens and closes over the full cycle.
cycleFacts.timing: Where you start depends on your natal lunar phase. Someone born near a New Moon reaches their progressed New Moon in their mid-to-late twenties; someone born near the Balsamic phase reaches it early in life.
cycleFacts.note: This slow rhythm gives context to even long outer-planet transits. The progressed New Moon can read like a ending-and-renewal, similar in feel to a heavy Pluto transit.

classes.relatedCycles: Pairs with saturn_return.json: the progressed lunar return (what makes you happy) often precedes the Saturn return's call to build on it.

phases.name: Progressed New Moon
phases.plainTranslation: Beginning and ending at once. A chapter, role, or public identity closes, often with loss, mourning, or a quiet, low-profile stretch. A seed is planted but still underground: the new direction isn't visible yet. The pull is toward home, roots, and the private core.
phases.guidance: Don't force the direction. Allow the dreamtime, reconnect to roots, let the new identity form before committing.

phases.name: Progressed Crescent
phases.plainTranslation: Time to move, even when it's unclear. The New Moon's dream needs first concrete steps. A steep learning curve follows: new job, new role, new relationship, all unfamiliar.
phases.guidance: Start anyway. Take the risk to express yourself, then do the unglamorous work. Accept help and mentors. Don't over-analyze yet.

phases.name: Progressed First Quarter
phases.plainTranslation: A clean break from the past. Independence, sometimes forced, often through a test of strength or judgment. You face others now: partners, rivals, competition, the public arena. Marriage and divorce are both common here.
phases.guidance: Take the risk. Lean on peers and allies. Face judgment instead of avoiding it.

phases.name: Progressed Gibbous
phases.plainTranslation: Everything grows: ambition, stakes, emotions, and problems. Horizons widen and you reach higher, building toward a climax. The risk is overdoing it: overwork, overspending, burning out.
phases.guidance: Invest toward the goal, but watch the excess. You're building toward delivery, not there yet.

phases.name: Progressed Full Moon
phases.plainTranslation: The peak: climax or anti-climax. Achievement or disappointment, both possible, both public. Maximum visibility and maximum clarity. Detachment and separation run strong: distance from home, polarization, the urge to shed the old.
phases.guidance: See clearly. Accept the result, release the energy, and set new objectives once the dust settles.

phases.name: Progressed Disseminating
phases.plainTranslation: The going-home turn. Share what you gained: teach, give back, fold the result into the collective. You find your niche, your people, your cause, or you reflect and process a disappointment.
phases.guidance: Spread the harvest, build networks, carry the lesson back into ordinary life. Watch the drift into hiding or forgetting.

phases.name: Progressed Last Quarter
phases.plainTranslation: A wake-up call. You move from the collective back to the self, with urgent questions about who you are, what you want, and what's left undone. The fear here is future-facing: that you've left things too late.
phases.guidance: Shake free of distractions, focus, and act on the undone thing while there's time.

phases.name: Progressed Balsamic
phases.plainTranslation: The world gets quieter and more concentrated. Supports and structures may fall away; dreams may be shelved; energy and health may dip. It's the cycle's release and closure, the time for last words. It can also be the late harvest of the waning half, when long-held rewards finally arrive.
phases.guidance: Let go of what holds you back, say the unsaid, find closure. Protect the small new seed forming for the next cycle. Rest, regroup, and seek support if you're depleted.

prohibitions: Do not use progressed lunation phase as a deterministic prediction of events.
Do not describe the Balsamic phase as failure, disappearance, or doom.
Do not use age alone when calculated progressions are available.
Do not collapse progressed lunation into ordinary New Moon or Full Moon ritual content.
weighting: Exact progressed Sun-Moon separation determines the phase.
Phase changes are multi-year thresholds and deserve stronger weight near phase boundaries.
Angular phases are louder: New Moon near IC, First Quarter near Descendant, Full Moon near MC, Last Quarter near Ascendant.
Natal lunar phase changes when a person reaches each progressed phase; personalize timing from the natal chart.

orbs.phaseRanges: Use the eight 45-degree phase bands supplied in classes.phases.degreeRange.
orbs.thresholdWindow: Give extra interpretive weight when the progressed Sun-Moon separation is within about 2 degrees of a phase boundary.
